---
title: "Week 6: Where Can Data Science Take Me?"
---

This week we look beyond the undergraduate degree: the work people do with data, what graduate education prepares you to do, and how experience changes your responsibilities.

[Open the lecture slides](slides/day6.qmd){.primary-link}

## During class

- Explore examples of work in companies, research organizations, government, and universities.
- Compare the preparation offered by bachelor's, master's, and doctoral degrees.
- Consider the difference between research independence and organizational leadership.
- Begin your final reflection, complete the course feedback survey, and discuss your questions.
